from miniconf.loader import load, loads
''')
s=s.replace('''

if __name__''','''

class IncludeTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self._tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.dir = self._tmp.name
        self.addCleanup(self._tmp.cleanup)

    def write(self, name, text):
        path = os.path.join(self.dir, name)
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
        with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            fh.write(text)
        return path

    def test_inline_and_override_order(self):
        self.write("inc.conf", "a = 1\\nb = 2\\n")
        main = self.write("main.conf", "a = 0\\n@include inc.conf\\nb = 3\\n")
        cfg = load(main)
        self.assertEqual(cfg.get("a"), 1)
        self.assertEqual(cfg.get("b"), 3)

    def test_nested_relative_to_including_file(self):
        self.write("sub/leaf.conf", "leaf = yes\\n")
        self.write("sub/mid.conf", "@include leaf.conf\\n")
        main = self.write("main.conf", "@include sub/mid.conf\\n")
        self.assertEqual(load(main).get("leaf"), True)

    def test_missing_include(self):
        main = self.write("main.conf", "@include nope.conf\\n")
        with self.assertRaises(ConfigError):
            load(main)

    def test_self_include(self):
        main = self.write("main.conf", "@include main.conf\\n")
        with self.assertRaises(ConfigError):
            load(main)

    def test_transitive_cycle(self):
        self.write("b.conf", "@include a.conf\\n")
        a = self.write("a.conf", "@include b.conf\\n")
        with self.assertRaises(ConfigError):
            load(a)

    def test_repeated_include_is_not_cycle(self):
        self.write("inc.conf", "x = 1\\n")
        main = self.write("main.conf", "@include inc.conf\\n@include inc.conf\\n")
        self.assertEqual(load(main).get("x"), 1)


if __name__''')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
python3 -m unittest discover -s . 2>&1 | tail -3
